E-7-1 has a 'change' document list, so the edge is expressible. The 'no open work option at all' part is wrong: a reader with edu:4 and rank:3 (what D-10-T requires) meets F-2-T's first alternative {edu:4, rank:3}, so F-2-T stays OPEN; only E-7-T is blocked, by its experience 8/5 requirement (checked with the engine's checkNeeds logic). The proposed F-2-7S edge is not supported: F-2-7S needs a Korean K-STAR STEM master's or PhD (koreanEdu:4), but the degree that qualifies someone for D-10-T is a foreign top-100 one.

verdicts.reason: In the repo, F-4 is reached only from B-1, B-2, C-3-*, H-2 and NONE, and no D-10 code offers it. Article 7(2) of the Enforcement Decree of the Overseas Koreans Act (재외동포법 시행령 제7조②) presumes that an ethnic Korean staying under another status can get a change-of-status permit to F-4. MOFA's notice states it directly for anyone already in Korea on another status. Since 2026-02-12 H-2 has been merged into F-4, so Chinese and CIS ethnic Koreans also get F-4. F-4 has a 'change' document list, and its needs {korean:true} gate the option, so non-Koreans who answered are blocked. The minor overstatements (F-4 still bars some 단순노무 jobs) do not affect the edge.
